title: Counterexamples to the Polishchuk--Van den Bergh conjecture on curves
summary: We construct effective finite group actions on smooth projective complex curves for which Conjecture A of Polishchuk and Van den Bergh fails. For every $h\geq1$, an explicit $S_3$ action on the smooth projective model of $y^2=t^{12h-5}+t$ has quotient of genus $h$ and exactly one ramification orbit, with inertia of order three. The fixed quotient for the three-cycle class consists of two points, but its derived category admits no $\C$-linear exact fully faithful embedding into the equivariant derived category.
